title: Drillhole / assay table checks
notice: Read-only. Censored values and formulas stay unchanged. No unit conversion or desurveying.
irrelevant: No relevant drillhole / assay column combination found. You may map roles manually.
proposal: Suggestions use column names. Confirm or edit roles before checking.
limits: Read limits: 16 MiB/file, 20,000 rows, 64 columns, 200,000 cells, 4 MiB parsed data. First 200 findings shown. Data rows start at 1 after the header. CSV/TSV source rows are physical record-start line numbers.
stale: Confirm roles and declarations, then run checks to see results.
id_mapping_required: No unique ID role, or hole IDs are expected to repeat.
unit_mapping_required: Map a unit column or declare a unit.
interval_mapping_required: Map hole ID, from and to depths.
interval_rows_skipped: Rows with unknown ID, invalid intervals, unknown or conflicting depth units were not compared.
row_wider_than_header: Stopped before a row wider than the header.
join_data_limit: Only part of the other table was read.
